author: QuiteShayne
quote: A game notoriously known for being basically a violence simulator doesn't allow you to be. The performance is not optimized, the characters have the personality of a rock, the story is boring, annoying "realistic" mechanics which are pointless because it's a game, yoy're supposed to play and instead you have to do everyday chores to be able to play. The game famous to be absolute freedom doesn't let you do anything
